title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Cebu Review: Runrio's Night Race in the Queen City
seo_title: HOKA Midnight Run Cebu 2026 Review | Philippines Night Race
meta_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Cebu: October 11 in Cebu City. 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio — a HOKA night race in the Philippines' Queen City of the South.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 in Cebu City, this HOKA-branded midnight run is produced by Runrio. Three distances. A brand-backed night race in the Philippines' second-largest metropolitan centre.
verdict: HOKA Midnight Run Asia Cebu brings the HOKA-Runrio night-race combination to Cebu City — the Philippines' 'Queen City of the South' and the country's oldest urban centre. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) produced by Runrio. Cebu's mix of urban infrastructure and heritage streets, combined with the HOKA brand's premium positioning, makes this a distinctive night-race experience. Registration isn't open yet, but for a Runrio-HOKA production in one of the Philippines' most vibrant cities, it's a priority track.

sections.heading: Cebu: The Queen City After Dark
paragraphs: Cebu City is the Philippines' oldest city and second-largest urban centre — a destination with heritage landmarks, a vibrant food scene, and easy access to beaches and diving. [1] A HOKA-Runrio midnight race through the city's streets combines world-class production with Cebu's unique urban energy.
